objects.description: An agency's standing with one model provider.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Minted when the row is written.

fields.name: agency_id
fields.description: The opaque id of the agency that owns the account, supplied by the host from the address. Never read from a request body.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the agency calls the account. Unique within one agency.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: The provider kind, which decides the adapter used to reach the model. A kind with no adapter is refused when the account is saved. No default.

fields.name: base_url
fields.description: The address of the provider's API.

fields.name: model_name
fields.description: The model the account asks for, in the provider's own words.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether the account may be used.

fields.name: key_set
fields.description: Whether a key is stored for the account. The key itself is never shown.

fields.name: last_test_result
fields.description: The outcome of the last test of the account. Written by the test operation.

fields.name: last_tested_at
fields.description: When the account was last tested.

fields.name: last_test_prompt
fields.description: The message the last test sent to the model. Written by the test operation; empty when no test has sent one, including a test that found no key.

fields.name: last_test_reply
fields.description: What the model answered to the last test, trimmed, without control characters, at most 120 characters. Written by the test operation; empty when the model did not answer. Dropped whole if it holds the account's key.

fields.name: last_test_ms
fields.description: How long the last test's call took, in whole milliseconds. Written by the test operation; zero when never tested or when no call was made.

fields.name: chat_enabled
fields.description: Whether the studio's chat may use the account. Off unless switched on. The module never requires one account to be on; the console does.

fields.name: chat_label
fields.description: The name the chat's picker shows for the account, at most 60 characters. Empty means the account's model name.

fields.name: is_default
fields.description: Whether the agency marked this account as its default. At most one account of an agency is the default; marking another moves it. Written by the set default operation only.

fields.name: tokens_per_call
fields.description: The most tokens one call may use. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: tokens_per_day
fields.description: The most tokens the account may use in a day. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: tokens_per_month
fields.description: The most tokens the account may use in a month. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: requests_per_day
fields.description: The most requests the account may make in a day. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: requests_per_minute
fields.description: The most requests the account may make in a minute. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: tokens_per_week
fields.description: The most tokens used in a rolling seven days. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: requests_per_week
fields.description: The most requests made in a rolling seven days. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: tokens_per_test
fields.description: The most tokens one test run may use. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: scenarios_at_once
fields.description: The most test scenarios that may run at the same time. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the account was added.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the account was last changed.

objects.description: The sealed key of an account, kept apart so that no operation can return it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The id of the account this key belongs to.

fields.name: agency_id
fields.description: The agency that owns the account.

fields.name: sealed
fields.description: The key sealed with AES-256-GCM under the host's master key. No operation reaches this object.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the key was last replaced.

objects.description: Requests and tokens used by one account, optionally for one AI role, in one minute, day or month window.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, derived from the window.

fields.name: agency_id
fields.description: The agency that owns the account.

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: The account used.

fields.name: role_id
fields.description: The AI role the use was for. Empty when none.

fields.name: window_kind
fields.description: The window kind.

fields.name: window_start
fields.description: UTC start of the window.

fields.name: requests
fields.description: Requests counted in the window.

fields.name: tokens_in
fields.description: Tokens sent in the window.

fields.name: tokens_out
fields.description: Tokens received in the window.

objects.description: Requests and tokens one test run used at one step, by one account and optionally one AI role.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, derived from the agency, the test run and the step.

fields.name: agency_id
fields.description: The agency that owns the account.

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: The account used.

fields.name: role_id
fields.description: The AI role the use was for. Empty when none.

fields.name: test_run_id
fields.description: The opaque id of the test run, supplied by the caller.

fields.name: step
fields.description: The opaque id of the step of the run. Empty when the caller names none.

fields.name: requests
fields.description: Requests counted at the step.

fields.name: tokens_in
fields.description: Tokens sent at the step.

fields.name: tokens_out
fields.description: Tokens received at the step.

objects.description: A named container for a system prompt: the agency's instructions for a seat, read live, followed by this role's own fine-tuning.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: agency_id
fields.description: The opaque id of the owning agency, from the address. Never read from a request body.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the agency calls the AI role. Unique within one agency.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the AI role is for.

fields.name: fine_tuning
fields.description: The agency's own additions to the prompt, at most 20000 characters. Required when the agency's instructions are switched off.

fields.name: use_agency_instructions
fields.description: Whether the agency's instructions for the seat come first in the prompt. On unless switched off.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether the AI role may be used.

fields.name: tokens_per_call
fields.description: The most tokens one call may use the AI role. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: tokens_per_day
fields.description: The most tokens it may use in a day the AI role. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: tokens_per_month
fields.description: The most tokens it may use in a month the AI role. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: requests_per_day
fields.description: The most requests it may make in a day the AI role. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: requests_per_minute
fields.description: The most requests it may make in a minute the AI role. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: tokens_per_week
fields.description: The most tokens used in a rolling seven days. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: requests_per_week
fields.description: The most requests made in a rolling seven days. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: tokens_per_test
fields.description: The most tokens one test run may use. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: scenarios_at_once
fields.description: The most test scenarios that may run at the same time. Null means it does not apply; zero means none.

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: The opaque id of the account this AI role calls the model through. Empty means none is mapped.

fields.name: agency_role_id
fields.description: The opaque id of the agency role this AI role speaks for. Empty means none.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the AI role was added.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the AI role was last changed.

objects.description: One model name listed for one provider kind, either on an agency's list from its last refresh or on the standard starting list.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: agency_id
fields.description: The agency whose account key listed the model. Empty on the standard starting list, which every agency sees.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: The provider kind the model belongs to, the same word an account carries.

fields.name: model_name
fields.description: The model in the provider's own words, as an account's model name takes it.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the entry came from: the provider's own list, or the standard starting list.

fields.name: listed_at
fields.description: When the entry was written.

indexes.name: provider_listing
indexes.description: Reading one provider kind's list for one agency.
